text: The two Vice Chairs of the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee are elected by the Members of the Committee for a term of office ending on November 14, 2026, and until successors are appointed. All members are eligible for election.

The Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee: 1. Elected Liv Mendelsohn and Dana Francoz as Vice Chairs of the Toronto Accessibility Advisory Committee for a term of office ending on November 14, 2026, and until successors are appointed.
